Definition: Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Mizpeh is the name of several places, all of them watchtowers. Joshua chased the northern kings to the valley of Mizpeh, one city of Judah bears the name, and Jephthah passed through Mizpeh of Gilead on his way to the Ammonites.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the name fits the land: a hill country needs watchtowers, and the places that watch are the places where the battles are decided.
